messages.subject: Executive Introduction | Mining, External Affairs, ESG & Strategic Partnerships | Australia
messages.body:
Dear Platina Resources Team,

I am writing to introduce my background for senior leadership opportunities where mining, external affairs, stakeholder strategy, sustainability, government relations, partnerships or corporate development intersect.

I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and cross-functional execution in a major gold-mining environment. My career spans more than 12 years across multinational mining, regulated financial services and commercial operations.

I am internationally mobile and open to relocation. My executive CV is attached for consideration. I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding relevant current or future opportunities.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
